summary: Verification of monitoring period 2027-01-01 to 2027-12-31 (MR MR-2027-001) against VCS v5.0 and VMR0015 v1.0, reasonable assurance, 5% materiality. Document review, site visit and recalculation. 0 CARs, 1 CL (closed), 0 FARs. Verified reductions: 1,556.947181 tCO2e.

s1_introduction.objective: To assess whether the project meets the VCS Program rules and correctly applies VMR0015.
s1_introduction.scopeAndCriteria: VCS Standard v5.0, VMR0015 v1.0, AMS-III.AV v09.0 and its tools; scope: MR MR-2027-001 and its records.
s1_introduction.summaryDescriptionOfProject: Kilimanjaro Safe Water Project: free distribution and maintenance of 3,000 gravity-fed ceramic-membrane household filters with a solar-assisted UV stage to 3,000 households (about 12,000 people) in four zones (Kibosho, Uru, Old Moshi and Mbokomu wards of Moshi Rural District, Kilimanjaro Region, Tanzania). The filters replace boiling of drinking water on three-stone woody-biomass fires. Emission reductions are quantified with VMR0015 v1.0 / AMS-III.AV v09.0.
